Title: Best crust in town
Review: The sourdough crust is chewy and blistered. We ordered the margherita and the mushroom one; both were excellent.

Title: Delivery was faster than promised
Review: Ordered at 7pm on a Friday and it arrived in 25 minutes. The pizza was still hot and the driver was friendly.

Title: Wrong topping, fixed quickly
Review: They sent a pepperoni instead of the vegetarian pizza. One call and a new pizza arrived in 20 minutes, no charge.

Title: Too salty for me
Review: The crust was good but the tomato sauce was very salty. I could not finish more than two slices.

Title: Great gluten-free option
Review: The gluten-free base is the best I have had locally. It does not fall apart and they cook it on a separate tray.

Title: Slow on a Saturday
Review: We waited 70 minutes for delivery. The pizza was fine when it arrived but the wait was too long for a weeknight.

Title: Vegan cheese works
Review: The vegan cheese melts well and does not taste like plastic. It costs two euros extra, which is reasonable.

Title: Family lunch deal
Review: Two large pizzas and a salad for 32 euros fed four of us. The lunch deal runs until 3pm on weekdays.

Title: Parking is difficult
Review: The pizza is good but the restaurant is on a narrow street with almost no parking. Take the tram or order delivery.

Title: Perfect for a birthday
Review: They reserved a long table for ten people and brought the pizzas out together. The staff sang happy birthday, which the kids loved.

Title: Undercooked in the middle
Review: The center of the base was doughy and the cheese was not fully melted. The edges were nicely charred, though.

Title: App ordering is easy
Review: The app remembers my last order and lets me add a note about the buzzer. Pickup was ready exactly on time.

Title: Best pepperoni slice
Review: The pepperoni cups crisp at the edges and the chili honey on top is a great combination. I would order it again.

Title: Portion is smaller than before
Review: The same large pizza feels smaller than it did last year. The taste is still good but the value has dropped.

Title: Staff know the menu
Review: I asked which pizza was mildest for my daughter and the server recommended the burrata one. It was perfect and she ate the whole slice.

Title: Refund handled without fuss
Review: The delivery was 30 minutes late and the manager refunded the delivery fee without me having to argue.

Title: Loud inside
Review: The food is good but the room is loud when full. Ask for a table on the terrace if the weather is nice.

Title: Great lunch special
Review: A slice, a small salad and a drink for 12 euros. The pizza of the day was the mushroom and truffle one.

Title: Burnt bottom
Review: The bottom was black in the middle, not just the edges. They offered a replacement but we had already waited 40 minutes.

Title: Good for groups
Review: We were eight people and the staff split the bill without a problem. The vegetarian options are clearly marked.
